missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces showing the internal error or exception behind the 500 response
Order service metrics (error rate, latency) to confirm the failure is server-side and sustained
candidates.statement: The order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout; the fault originates in the order service, not the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: The specific internal cause of the order 500 (e.g., downstream inventory/payment/postgres failure) is not established by current evidence.

report.explanation: Traces and logs show gateway POST /v1/checkout returning 502 because the downstream order service returns 500 on POST /v1/orders across all correlated requests. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The bounded root cause is an order-service HTTP 500 propagating to the gateway; the deeper internal cause remains unproven.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces and metrics to identify the internal cause of the 500 responses
